heading: Security Cover

chapter.title: OBLIGATIONS OF LISTED ENTITY WHICH HAS LISTED ITS NON- CONVERTIBLE 459[***] SECURITIES 460[***]

content:
54. 517[(1) In respect of its 518[secured] listed non-convertible debt securities, the listed entity
shall maintain hundred per cent. 519[security cover or higher security cover] as per the
terms of offer document/Information Memorandum and/or Debenture Trust Deed,
sufficient to discharge the principal amount 520[and the interest thereon] at all times for
the non-convertible debt securities issued.]
(2) The listed entity shall disclose to the stock exchange in quarterly, half-yearly, year-
to-date and annual financial statements, as applicable, the extent and nature of security
created and maintained with respect to its secured listed non-convertible debt securities.
521[***]
522[(3) The listed entity shall disclose the 523[security cover] available in case of non-
convertible debt securities along with its financial results in the format as specified by
the Board.]

footnotes.text:
516 Substituted for the words “Asset Cover” by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations

517 Substituted by the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) (Third Amendment) Regulations,

“(1) In respect of its listed non-convertible debt securities, the listed entity shall maintain hundred percent. asset
cover sufficient to discharge the principal amount at all times for the non-convertible debt securities issued.”

518 Inserted by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)

519 Substituted for the words “asset cover or higher asset cover” by the Securities and Exchange Board of India
